notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
SYN scan (-sS) with source port set to 53 (--source-port 53). Packets appear as DNS responses — firewall rules whitelisting DNS source port 53 pass them without inspection. In example: port 50000 filtered normally → open when sourced from port 53.

=== CONFIRMATION FLOW ===
1. Normal SYN scan: port filtered 2. --source-port 53 SYN scan: port shows open 3. ncat --source-port 53 to that port: confirms full connection possible 4. Service is fully accessible via DNS-sourced packets.

=== TARGET ===
Stateless ACL rules matching 'src port 53 = permit'. Won't bypass stateful firewalls that track connection state and validate that DNS responses come from DNS servers.
